versions.changelog:
- Skill描述优化：名称由“B站关键词实时搜索”调整为“B站关键词搜作品”，定位及触发词更广泛。
- 流程表述简化：去除“实时”字段，突出“最新/热门/搜作品”等核心场景。
- 指引更易懂：减少冗余说明，优化步骤描述，关注实际用法与筛选指令指引。
- 保持主要功能流程一致，仅对表达、提示文本及部分术语做统一，适应更多用户需求。
- 移除 skill-card.md 文件，减少文档冗余。

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- SKILL.md: Significantly simplified and reworded the feature and value section for more concise, user-friendly language.
- No functional or interface logic altered in code or skill design. 
- Documentation now focuses on straightforward benefits and usage, with process/parameter sections preserved.

- Initial release of the B站关键词实时搜索 (bilibili real-time keyword search) skill.
- Supports real-time B站 (bilibili) video searches using user input keywords with Redfox API, providing non-cached, up-to-date results.
- Features flexible sorting (综合/最新/点赞) and time filters (7/30/90 days or unlimited), with intelligent keyword expansion if no results found.
- Provides paginated search results and allows users to subscribe to daily keyword pushes.
- Step-by-step workflow ensures clear extraction of intent, parameterization, single script invocation per search, and formatted result presentation with subscription prompts.
